checks.description: Provider-native tool call/result pairing is preserved.
History is append-only with a stable cache-friendly prefix.
Large observations can be externalized and restored on demand.
Long sessions compact automatically without silently losing task state.
Execution survives client disconnect.
Long tasks can run in a background or hosted environment.
A run can resume or replay from persisted state.
Multi-step work externalizes and updates a plan.
The loop tracks explicit completion criteria and reports incomplete work honestly.
Side effects or artifacts are verified by an independent observation.
Failures remain visible to the model so it can adapt.
Repeated failures have a retry budget or circuit breaker.
Conversation working memory persists across turns.
The agent has a task workspace for durable artifacts or scratch state.
Approved preferences or project knowledge persist across sessions.
Independent actions can execute concurrently.
Subagents run with isolated context and return bounded summaries.
Policy is enforced at each action boundary.
Risky actions support confirmation followed by continuation.
Execution and data are isolated to the authorized scope.
A structured action/result trace is inspectable.
The user can see meaningful progress during long work.
The UI reconnects to an in-progress run without losing history.
Per-run token, cost, latency, and failure telemetry are visible.
Completion or handoff clearly states outcome, evidence, and remaining work.
